The packaged standard-library checker explicitly replays 7 tree edges, 22 homotopy-preserving 1/2-cell cancellations, verifies ∂1∂2=0 and finds attaching words t^5,1,1. Armstrong applies since K is simply connected by established shellability; each reflection fixes a vertex and no nontrivial C5 rotation does. Connected simply connected two-dimensional quotients are wedges of 2-spheres. Lift the cyclic Moore-plus-spheres quotient equivalence to the universal cover to obtain I⊕R². Domain and all eight subgroups are explicit.

value.rationale: The natural complete classification of all eight subgroup quotients of the smallest simply connected noncrossing-partition proper-part complex isolates an integral torsion-vs-sphere-wedge transition under adding reflections. A Moore-space 2-cell attaching degree and full integral covering-module lattice answer topological information not supplied by Catalan orbit enumeration, rational characters or Euler numbers. The fixed pentagonal size is mathematically canonical rather than arbitrary.
